deadline.value: International military/government packages must arrive at AFIT/IMSO by April 30, 2027 for September 2027 entrance; year-round applications should be submitted at least 3 months before desired enrollment.
deadline.quote: Application packages for eligibility evaluation should arrive at the IMSO no later than 30 April of each year in preparation for entrance the following September.

also.quote: AFIT applications are processed year-round, however, you should submit your application at least three months prior to the date you wish to enroll.

gre_subject.value: ETS offers no GRE Subject Test in Mechanical & Aerospace Engineering (Subject Tests exist only in Mathematics, Physics, and Psychology).
gre_subject.quote: The GRE Subject Tests in Mathematics, Physics and Psychology measure undergraduate achievement in a particular field of study

supervisor.value: Prospective doctoral students are advised to discuss their interests with an active departmental faculty researcher before applying; M.S. thesis advisor endorsement is also required.
supervisor.quote: Students interested in a doctoral program should discuss those interests with a member of the department who is actively engaged in research in an area of interest to the student. | Must have endorsement by the student's MS faculty, especially by the MS thesis advisor.

funding.value: Students assigned full-time by the Department of the Air Force or military organizations in a fully-sponsored capacity incur no tuition liability; all other students are responsible for tuition ($434.00/credit hour in 2026-2027) unless supported by their home government via U.S. Embassy SAO, DAGSI scholarships, or research assistantships.
funding.quote: All other students are responsible for their financial obligations, including tuition. | DAGSI scholarships are the major source of financial aid for non-DoD civilian students. However, other grants and scholarships may be sourced and used by the student. Research assistantships are also available.

also.quote: International military officers are asked to contact United States (U.S.) Security Assistance Office (SAO) at the U.S. Embassy in their home country to determine if their government will support studies at AFIT's Graduate School of Engineering and Management.

entry_route.value: Requires a Bachelor's and Master's degree (M.S. thesis desirable) with endorsement by the student's M.S. faculty/thesis advisor (3.50 MS GPA, 3.00 BS GPA).
entry_route.quote: Degree Required: Bachelor's degree and Master's degree with successful completion of an MS thesis (desirable).

gre_general.value: Aeronautical Engineering (along with Astronautical Engineering and Space Systems) requires higher GRE scores of 156 Verbal and 166 Quantitative within the last five years.
gre_general.quote: Test Required: GRE - 156V/166Q (within the last five years)

notes: Department of Aeronautics & Astronautics also offers Ph.D.s in Astronautical Engineering (https://www.afit.edu/EN/programs.cfm?a=view&D=4) and Space Systems (https://www.afit.edu/EN/programs.cfm?a=view&D=7), both requiring 156V/166Q GRE. Department of Systems Engineering and Management offers a Ph.D. in Systems Engineering (https://www.afit.edu/EN/programs.cfm?a=view&D=51, GRE 156V/160Q).
name: Ph.D. in Aeronautical Engineering
